source_refs.note: 11- Centrioles: a main subheading of 3.4 Structure of the cell, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 75-76.

blocks.text: Janwaron aur zyada tar protists ke cells mein centrioles woh organelles hain jo cytoskeleton ke fibres, yani microtubules (spindle fibres samet), ko jorne aur tarteeb dene se jure hain.
Centrioles khokhle (hollow) aur cylinder jaise organelles hain. Ek centriole microtubules ke nau (9) triplets se bana hai.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Eukaryotic cells mein centrioles jore (pairs) mein hote hain. Dono centrioles nuclear envelope ke qareeb ek doosre se seedhe zaviye (right angle, 90°) par hote hain. Cilia ya flagella wale cells mein centrioles cilia aur flagella banane mein hissa lete hain. Har cilium aur flagellum ek centriole par jama hota hai jise basal body kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do centrioles jo aapas mein seedhe zaviye (right angle) par hain: ek saamne se nau microtubule triplets ka challa dikhata hai, doosra khara hua khokhla belan (cylinder) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.26: Do centrioles (textbook ki Figure 3.26 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Podon aur fungi ke cells mein centrioles aur basal bodies nahi hote; un ke microtubules aur spindle fibres cytoplasm ki doosri structures se tarteeb pate hain.
